name: ListRouteTargetGroups

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC to which the route target group belongs
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of route target group IDs.

You can specify up to 50 instance IDs in a single query
parameters.help_zh:
路由目标组实例ID列表。

单次查询最多支持传入50个实例ID
parameters.name: route_target_group_ids

parameters.help_en: The ID of a route target group member instance. This parameter filters route target groups that contain the specified member instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
路由目标组成员实例ID。
筛选成员包含传入成员实例ID的路由目标组
parameters.name: member_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，取值范围：1~50，默认值：50
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. If not all results are returned in a query, a value is returned for NextToken. In the next query, set NextToken to this value
parameters.help_zh: 是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the VPC to which the route target group belongs. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 路由目标组所属的VPC的地域ID。您可以通过调用DescribeRegions接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group. For more information about resource groups, see What is a resource group
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID。关于资源组的更多信息，请参见什么是资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters. If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh: 客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。说明 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

RouteTargetGroups.description_en: The list of route target groups

ConfigMode.description_en:
The configuration mode of the route target group. Valid values:

Active-Standby: active/standby mode
ConfigMode.description_zh:
路由目标组的配置模式，支持模式如下：

Active-Standby: 主备模式

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the route target group was created
CreateTime.description_zh: 创建路由目标组的时间

RegionId.description_en:
The region ID of the VPC to which the route target group belongs.

You can call the [DescribeRegions]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html） operation to query the region ID
RegionId.description_zh:
路由目标组所属的VPC的地域ID。

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html）接口获取地域ID

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group to which the route target group belongs
ResourceGroupId.description_zh: 路由目标组所属的资源组ID

RouteTargetGroupDescription.description_en: The description of the route target group

RouteTargetGroupId.description_en: The routing target group instance ID

RouteTargetGroupName.description_en: The name of the route target group

RouteTargetMemberList.description_en: The list of members in the route target group
RouteTargetMemberList.description_zh: 路由目标组的成员列表

items.description_en: The list of members in the route target group
items.description_zh: 路由目标组的成员列表

EnableStatus.description_en:
The enable status of the route target group member. Valid values:

Enable: Enabled.
Disable: Disabled.

Only members in the Disable state can be modified to other instances. Members in the Enable state cannot be modified
EnableStatus.description_zh:
路由目标组成员使能状态。取值：

Enable：使能中。
Disable：未使能。

只有未使能状态的路由目标组成员允许被修改为其他实例。使能中的路由目标组成员禁止修改

HealthCheckStatus.description_en:
The health check status of the route target group member. Valid values:

Normal: Normal.
Abnormal: Abnormal
HealthCheckStatus.description_zh:
路由目标组成员健康检查状态。取值：

Normal：正常
Abnormal：状态异常

MemberId.description_en: The routing target group member instance ID

MemberType.description_en:
The member type of the route target group.

Currently supported types:

GatewayLoadBalancerEndpoint
MemberType.description_zh:
路由目标组的成员类型。

当前支持的类型：

GatewayLoadBalancerEndpoint

Weight.description_en:
The weight of the route target group member. Valid values:

100: The member is the active instance.
0: The member is the standby instance.

The weight can only be set during creation and cannot be modified
Weight.description_zh:
路由目标组成员的权重值。取值：

100：表示成员为主实例。
0：表示成员为备实例。

权重值仅支持在创建时设置，不支持修改

Status.description_en:
The status of the routing target group. Valid values:

Recovering: The active/standby switchback is in progress.
Switched: The active/standby switchover is complete.
Available: Available.
Abnormal: The standby instance has instance failures.
Pending: Being created.
Switching: The active/standby switchover is in progress.
Deleting: Being deleted.
Unavailable: Both primary and secondary instances have instance failures
Status.description_zh:
路由目标组的状态。取值：

Recovering：主备回切中
Switched：主备已切换
Available：可用
Abnormal：备实例异常
Pending：创建中
Switching：主备切换中
Deleting：删除中
Unavailable：主备实例均异常
